ai_positioning.summary: Cummins Inc. does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning or related technologies in its 2025 10-K filing. The company focuses on traditional powertrain technologies, electrification and zero-emission solutions.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Company has established enterprise and product cybersecurity governance with dedicated leadership reporting to board committees, but faces material risks from IT asset protection, customer data security and product vulnerability management (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Cybersecurity is a significant risk for enterprise operations, stakeholder data protection and product integrity, with governance structure in place through CISO and Chief Technical Officer oversight

risks.title: Demand Cyclicality
risks.score_rationale: Financial performance heavily dependent on demand fluctuations in on-highway, off-highway, power generation and industrial markets, all sensitive to economic cycles (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company is exposed to cyclical demand patterns in markets served, impacting sales volume and pricing power across all reportable segments

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Operates in highly competitive global markets with multiple manufacturers and distributors offering similar products, risking market share and pricing pressure (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Intense competitive environment across all product segments and geographic regions requires continuous innovation and market positioning efforts

risks.title: Regulatory and Trade Risks
risks.score_rationale: Exposed to evolving environmental regulations, trade tariffs and geopolitical tensions. 2023 settlement agreements with EPA/CARB resulted in $2.0 billion charge; ongoing tariff uncertainty impacts 2026 outlook (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company faces material regulatory compliance costs, tariff impacts and uncertain global trade environment affecting operations and profitability

risks.title: Supply Chain Dependency
risks.score_rationale: Dependent on global supplier network for component availability and quality; supply chain disruptions can impact production and costs across all markets (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Supply chain vulnerabilities affect operational efficiency and ability to meet customer demand, particularly in volatile geopolitical environment

risks.title: Energy Transition Execution
risks.score_rationale: Accelera segment faces severe challenges in electrification markets; $458 million in 2025 charges from electrolyzer impairment and hydrogen market deterioration indicates execution risk in zero-emission transition (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Strategic transition to electrified powertrains and zero-emission technologies facing market headwinds; significant capital investments and market uncertainty require successful technology commercialization
